stage3.sig: WEB to DB direct - microsegmentation bypass

summary.thesis_claim: Proposed agent escalates with kill-chain context (higher confidence, correlation markers present); SOAR correctly mitigates on SID match but cannot escalate, correlate across stages, or distinguish cold vs. sequence.

reasoning: SID 9000001 triggered: TCP SYN from WEB zone (10.1.100.10) to DB-OLTP zone (10.1.200.10) on PostgreSQL port 5432 - matches detection logic for microsegmentation bypass.
Policy matrix confirms WEB→DB-OLTP = DENY - this is a hard microsegmentation violation; legitimate traffic must flow WEB→APP-GW→APP-CORE→DB-OLTP.

Baseline check: No web-to-db traffic exists in production baselines; WEB's only legitimate outbound is web-to-appgw-proxy (10.3.100.10:8080). DB-OLTP only accepts from APP-CORE, WORKER, MGT, MONITORING.
Source reputation: 10.1.100.10 has trust score 0.39, runtime score 0.00 (very low), 28 prior SID 9000001 alerts in 90 days - classified as REPEAT OFFENDER.
Past incidents: 100% enforcement rate (28/28) for exact SID matches in 90-day lookback; all recent decisions were DROP with 0.95 confidence; 5 semantically similar and 5 MITRE T1021 matches.
Multi-alert correlation: 5-alert sequence (SIDs 9000001, 9000001, 9000901, 9000905, 9000002) indicates active kill-chain progression - not isolated event.

Threat pattern match: `cross_zone_violation_web_to_db` with confidence anchor 0.95; severity scoring yields 10 points (cross_zone_policy_violation +4, dst_port_in_critical_db_set +1, corroborated_by_past_incidents +1, matches_known_chain_stage +2, rate_above_3x_baseline +2) → P1.
Confidence gate: 0.95 >= 0.85 threshold passes L7 safety check; targeted block (src+dst+port) selected to preserve legitimate web-to-appgw-proxy flow while blocking malicious path.
Hard overrides verified: src_zone != MGT, dst_ip not in NEVER_BLOCK list, action=DROP, priority=50 (<100) - all constraints satisfied.

hypotheses.name: Microsegmentation bypass attack
hypotheses.description: Microsegmentation bypass attack (probability=0.95) — WEB host attempting direct DB connection, bypassing APP-GW and APP-CORE. Evidence: SID 9000001 trigger, policy matrix DENY verdict, no baseline match, repeat offender with 28 prior incidents. Counter: None significant.

hypotheses.name: Misconfigured application
hypotheses.description: Misconfigured application (probability=0.04) — Application misconfigured to connect directly to DB instead of through proper chain. Evidence: None - no legitimate web-to-db baseline exists in production. Counter: 28 prior exact-SID incidents all enforced as malicious; no change window announced.

hypotheses.name: Lateral movement pivot
hypotheses.description: Lateral movement pivot (probability=0.01) — WEB host compromised, attacker pivoting toward crown-jewel DB. Evidence: Multi-SID kill-chain signal (9000001→9000901→9000905→9000002), MITRE T1021 mapping. Counter: Would expect reconnaissance SIDs (9000040/9000041) before direct DB access in typical attack chain.
